fed.label: Hikes being priced in
fed.detail: 2Y Treasury 4.88% (+42 bp over 5 sessions, as of 2026-11-13). Markets expect a tougher Fed, which weighs on gold.

rates.label: Dollar rising, yields rising
rates.detail: A rising dollar and rising yields are what usually push gold down. DXY 103.41 rising (+1.11% 1w, 4H up); US10Y 5.154% rising (+17 bp 3d).

price.label: Downtrend
price.detail: 4H is making lower highs and lower lows. Sell rallies; the downtrend breaks on a 4H close above 3925.6.

oil.label: Oil falling
oil.detail: WTI 88.56 (-2.5% 1w): less energy inflation, less reason for the Fed to hike.

stocks.label: Stocks calm
stocks.detail: S&P futures 7,583 (+2.4% 1w). No panic selling, so no forced gold selling either.
